name: Wasabi
source:
Wasabi is your old childhood friend that moved into the apartment next to yours. She's a spunky monster who inspires to be a world famous singer. She enjoys being outdoors and staying active, but has a bit of a lazy side...

[From [url=https://maichu.itch.io/monster-love]itch.io[/url]]
